How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Customers say

Customers find these sunglasses visually appealing, with one noting they look identical to more expensive Maui Jim models, and appreciate their great quality for the price. They receive positive feedback for their comfort, polarization, and clarity, with customers noting they don't cause headaches. The durability receives mixed reviews, with several customers reporting that the glasses came apart at the bridge. The lens tint also gets mixed reactions, with some finding the brown lenses not too dark while others note they are much darker than expected.

    I purchased the pink tortoise and ice blue versions of these glasses. The ice blue pair has yet to arrive, but unfortunately, the pink ones are a big disappointment.

    Based on the photos, I expected these to have a soft, sophisticated look. In reality, the pink is barely pink.     At this point, I have very low expectations for the blue pair. :-)

    The fit is OK, and the overall look is OK; they do seem well made. They just do not feel particularly sturdy.

  • Mike
    1 out of 5 stars
    Yeah, this ain't it. Real review right here.
    Reviewed in the United States on December 31, 2023
    Lens Color: C10-SilverMaterial Type: Polarized
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I wear Maui Jim's, Smiths, and Suncloud (also by Smith). I am used to high quality lenses, but I've always thought that "high quality" lenses were fairly common and easy to make, and I was just aa brand snob.

    These look exactly like Maui Jim's. I want a new style so... Ordered them.

    The fit: great.

    The wright: great.

    They feel durable.

    They feel comfortable.

    The style is great.

    The lenses: useless and I would honestly say no chance I'd wear these sunglasses. Literally zero chance. Why?

    1. Put these on and look at a regular light bulb. Any light bulb at home. You'll see three images of that light bulb, one to the left which is faint, one to the right which is faint, and the bulb itself in the middle. Not joking. It's as if there is a "glare". This is because the lenses are not perfect thickness and magnification, and the lens coating are layered poorly (I am guessing here). Put on a pair of Maui Jim's (or other high end brand) and you'll see just one light bulb.

    I'm not making this up. Try it.

    This will affect everything you look at, brighter objects more.

    2. Look at these glasses while wearing high end glasses. You'll see the polarization film -- especially around the bridge and arms. Now, look at the high end glasses through these. You wont see the polarization film (it's there, you just can't see it). High end lenses have much better and even polarization.

    The lenses on these glasses are simply too cheap, the flaws are really noticeable. I wish they were better, really do. I love this rimless style.
